file_change.purpose: Represent Planning-owned normative requirements, applicability dispositions, and non-circular ownership relationships.
implementation: Define immutable NormativeRequirement records with stable ID, one obligation statement, Conformance disposition, and Assurance disposition.
Require rationale whenever either applicability is none.
Represent controlling-owner and normative dependency relationships separately from Design addresses.
Provide cycle detection over normative dependency edges and enforce one controlling owner per independently governed invariant.
Represent stable authority identities and explicit delegation edges; reject unresolved delegated authority and authority edges inferred from implementation or historical state.
Represent derived primitive provenance to authorizing normative authority and keystone responsibility.
Represent normative lifecycle status and predecessor/successor identity for creation, amendment, supersession, and withdrawal while preserving historical resolution.
Enforce default-deny lookup: governed framework state without resolvable accepted authorization or a governed extension point is rejected rather than inferred as authorized.
Represent framework authority and product authority as distinct domains and reject product-originating attempts to define framework authority.
